prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished native raster 16:9 landscape game UI art design, one complete screen, no device mockup.
Primary request: create a new screen for this Daoist chibi Chinese arcade fish-catching game, faithfully matching the attached approved art family.
Input images: Image 1 approved mail UI and Image 2 approved team UI are primary art references only: copy their jade green and warm ivory silk-paper panel materials, delicate warm-gold border thickness, rounded soft cloud/ruyi ornaments, sophisticated high-finish hand-painted shading, readable Chinese, orderly information hierarchy and spacious layout. Do not copy their game names, character names, sample data, mail/team content or their layouts. Image 3 is the current fishing main-screen design: use its bright turquoise sea setting, jade/gold gourd cannon vocabulary and restrained fishing motifs for continuity.
Style: highly refined original Daoist Q/chibi hand-painted game art, rounded full shapes, jade/teal primary buttons and selected states, ivory secondary panels, subtle fine gold trim, quiet text areas, measured small red tassels. Bright clean finish with clear edges, no photorealism, no plastic toy 3D, no noisy texture.
Composition: one landscape game interface edge to edge; large central ivory window with ornate jade title plaque and circular jade/gold close X at top right, modest surrounding sea-world background, generous margins. Deep jade Chinese text must be clear and correctly spelled. Main actions jade/gold, secondary ivory/gold, locked/disabled states visually distinct. Keep titles and key values large enough to read.
Task-specific exact content and layout:
16:9 leaderboard 排行榜. Tabs 渔获 / 收藏 / 成长. Left ranked list of five rows with first three tasteful medals, distinct portraits and short names 渔舟客 / 青荷 / 云帆 / 海棠 / 见习渔师 and sample values; own row softly jade highlighted. Right modest winner portrait display and concise 本周渔获 18,600. Footer 我的排名 5, small cycle label 本周榜. No excessive gold or gambling jackpot language.
Constraints: All values are visual sample data. Preserve exact required short Chinese labels and numbers; do not add long paragraphs or other branding. Different items have distinct silhouettes. No watermark, commentary, code, fake screenshot captions or presentation grid. This is one final-looking game UI concept at native output resolution, not an upscaled image.
